payload.rationale: As of August 2026, Rocket Lab projected delivering the Neutron rocket to the launch pad in Q4 2026. Since delivery to the pad is a distinct milestone that precedes extensive pre-flight testing (such as wet dress rehearsals and static fires), achieving a launch before January 1, 2027, leaves very little margin for error. Aerospace timelines for maiden flights frequently experience delays during integrated testing. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that the Q4 pad delivery target itself might slip, or initial pad testing could uncover issues requiring months of remediation. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is that Rocket Lab might execute flawlessly, deliver the vehicle early in Q4, and complete testing rapidly enough to launch before the end of the year.
limitations: A company schedule is an interested-party forward-looking statement, not independently verified readiness.
The reviewed statement provides no exact launch date or completed integrated-test sequence.
Small coordinator-selected source packet; gaps remain and facts must not be confused with calibrated probabilities.
